notes.title: Version 1.2.1 of Bichito Clicker!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209976/14230fee9775ce045eea82df763197b28253d285.png[/img]



Version 1.2.1 of Bichito Clicker has just been released, here is the content it brings:

• Starting on October 25 at 3:00 p.m. UTC, the Halloween event will begin, which will bring several new aspects to the game. For one month these contents will be available to perform except in certain cases where the end date will be shortened. I hope you enjoy all the new content.

• From October 25 at 3:00 p.m. UTC until November 11 at 3:00 p.m. UTC, the game will receive small decorative changes, where everything will be more themed to the Halloween season. Additionally, on the 30th, Ox will receive a skin change until the decorative completion date.

• GraveLord Zombie got a Rework. His healing mechanics change completely, no longer depending on his amount of life, but rather on a hands that this rage creating on the platform. For more details, read their news section.

• General bug fixes.

More content to arrive on October 30, among these things, Resurger can finally be made for the first time, celebrating the first 6 months of Bichito Clicker on the air. Also, 2 bosses will receive a Rework, and one of them has not appeared in the game since it was shown in the Beta. Stay up to date with all the updates through this menu and also on our social networks listed above this message.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209976/f7caf32c5bdb6b2e1256da4366dd0ca9ab03a8a8.png[/img]



Be careful buddy! GraveLord Zombie changed his way of fighting. 

The Spit mechanic remained almost the same, only the maximum amount of Spit to be able to cast changed from 10 to 7 maximum. In turn, GraveLord Zombie will now be able to summon up to 7 Revitalizing Hands at a time. These hands will take part of the zombie's maximum life as their own life (without taking life away from GraveLord) and will subtract this taken life while healing the Boss Bug. Don't let them accumulate, hit them until they are destroyed! Otherwise it will be almost impossible to beat him. 

The more Revitalizing Hands GraveLord creates, the more likely it is that fewer hands will be created after the fight, but in turn the more chance he will have to summon more Spit. If there are already 7 Revitalizing Hands on the deck, until at least 1 is destroyed, no more hands will be created. GraveLord Zombie will no longer heal upon falling below a certain amount of health. 

Good luck buddy.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209976/680e803581a596e5598e2664ff8d8eb76b0e429d.png[/img]



This year, with the Bichito Clicker Team we will be exhibiting at Eva Play 2024 on October 25 and 26, from 2:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. GMT-3 at the Palacio Libertad (Sarmiento 151 – CABA, Argentina / former Correo Central). Bichito Clicker will be located at TERRAZA BALLENA, Stand 48. Admission to the place is FREE.

We are waiting for you with many gifts and new content to arrive in a not so future update, with the Halloween celebration in between. You can't miss it!

notes.title: PETS ARE HERE! Bichito Clicker 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209976/bc0e34ed3867226703b82e9af41601b7d1216f60.png[/img]


Version 1.0.2 of Bichito Clicker has just been released, here is the content it brings:

• Preparations for the pet summoning system. You can now collect them up to a maximum of 5 duplicates per pet. So far there are only 10 pets, they will increase in the future. During this week the skills will be applied to the pets, please be patient.

• More applied tutorials.

• Messaging system with the game developers. Read options panel for more information.

More content to come soon. Among them will come a Ludum Champion gaming system. A season pass and daily missions are also on the way. Stay up to date with all the updates through this menu and also on our social networks listed above this message. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209976/701bd5d4c350216ee31b6663a6739957439484aa.png[/img]


Certain errors from version 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 of Bichito Clicker have been corrected:

• Unexpected keys to be used during the Ludum Champion matchup.

• Rocker Hero exponentially increased the health of the next enemy no matter who it was, making it almost impossible to defeat.

• General game execution errors.

• Local save system implemented, to help improve the beta cloud save system.


Thank you for the patience and enormous support. If there is any other error, do not hesitate to report it through our social networks or the notebook in the Options menu. Greetings, colleague.

notes.title: FINALLY IS HERE! Bichito Clicker 1.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209976/bc0e34ed3867226703b82e9af41601b7d1216f60.png[/img]


Hi buddy, welcome to the magical world of Tostadeña, the home of chatty toast. We have been working on this first project for a long time. It has been a hard road with many mistakes and learnings, but we have finally reached the long-awaited version 1.0.0 of the game.

Over time, we will be implementing more and more content into the game. June will be a month of finalizing the integration of previously existing game content along with new things never seen before. Stay up to date with all the updates through this menu and also on our social networks listed above this message. Don't let Ozone control everything.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209976/701bd5d4c350216ee31b6663a6739957439484aa.png[/img]


Version 1.0.0 of Bichito Clicker has just been released, here is the content it brings:

• All Rebirth 0 up to level 150 available. Once that threshold is passed, the game will continue until infinity, but you will not be able to do a Rebirth until the Story Mode progresses. More Story Mode content coming in June.

• Ox, allies and their cards available for use.

• The vast majority of bosses in the Demo, except for 3 specific cases, are currently available for confrontation. During the month of June we will be implementing the missing bosses as well as new ones.

• Ozone Warning Indicator fully available.

• The “Wanted” System is fully available.

• Spanish and English fully available, subject to possible corrections. If you have any problems, do not hesitate to tell us about the problems through our social networks and contact emails.

• Saved Game in the Cloud transferable between platforms, something totally new in Bichito Clicker in its Beta mode. If you have any problems, do not hesitate to tell us about the problems through our social networks and contact emails.

•And much more…

More content to come soon. Among them will come a pet summoning system where these can give you improvements in battle. A Season Pass and daily missions are also coming. Stay up to date with all the updates through this menu and also on our social networks listed above this message. 
Don't let Ozone control everything, good luck buddy.
